preserved_unmerged_chapter.reused_behavior: Immediate dispatch of short hand-pinch pause; no duplicate movement or award owner.

design: Extend the existing pinned Three native XR renderer, not a second A-Frame scene lifecycle. Explicit AR/VR entry, alpha-composited clipped AR exhibit, stereo original 3D game, live 2D/editor canvases, paged real-DOM controls, bounded text keyboard, explicit confirmations and browser-owned action handoff.

acceptance.coverage: Actual original game, Three stereo renderer, real XR framebuffer readback, DOM controls and modern Workshop pointer handlers with emulated tracking and standard Xbox samples. AR and VR entry, size/rotation/recenter ownership, route/Flight Deck/journal/graphics/sound menus, checkbox/select state, tracked and hand riding, brief pinch pause, live 2D, Xbox-triggered text keyboard, real field edit/undo, cancelled replacement and import handoff, native editor pan/capture loss, 3D playtest/return, deliberate AR/VR switching, exit and denied re-entry. No player, score, delivery, win or campaign-state assignments manufacture acceptance.
acceptance.delivery_result: Twelve actual mailbox deliveries in a first-attempt native road journey. Real 3D inspection followed by supported 2D CPU completion. Returning to Workshop restores protected credit/save fixtures; all eight campaign builders remain identical.
acceptance.legacy_gesture_evidence: Five isolated tests execute the actual pointer-dispatch function. Claimed curve gestures suppress duplicate mouse paint; native legacy mouseup ends a stroke on source loss; modern Workshop retains pointercancel. This does not certify every legacy Bezier gesture on hardware.

retained_failures.observed: Two reported eye views but zero opaque pixels and a null output target.
retained_failures.correction: Install the application animation callback before r177 XRManager.setSession captures it; preserve its camera/framebuffer wrapper and defer app cleanup until its synchronous session-end cleanup finishes. Strict framebuffer/pixel checks remain.

retained_failures.scope: Ambiguous Back selected Back to game before editor pan
retained_failures.correction: Distinct Resume editing action and direct Select/Pan controls; native tests require active Workshop, correct tool and actual drag before measuring pan.

retained_failures.scope: Delivery test read Flight Deck before module readiness
retained_failures.correction: Wait for the real Flight Deck dependency before reading its records. Delivery/physics/persistence assertions are unchanged.

retained_failures.scope: Split-page plus/minus focus jumped to first occurrence
retained_failures.correction: Retain the currently visible occurrence of the focused DOM element before revealing an off-page occurrence. Four deterministic regressions and the native portal path pass.

retained_failures.scope: Test waited for XR frames after deliberately ending the session
retained_failures.correction: The helper observes intentional session termination instead of waiting for nonexistent XR frames. Explicit draft, re-entry and restored-owner assertions remain.

retained_failures.scope: Raw style contents and concatenated route metadata in labels
retained_failures.correction: Prefer explicit accessible names and rendered innerText; route cards use their real heading. Added three label tests and reviewed corrected native captures.

Respect preventDefault from pointer-aware tools before starting compatibility mouse painting. On tracking loss use legacy mouseup/undo ownership rather than nonexistent mousecancel. Modern pointer cancellation is unchanged. Five isolated actual-dispatch tests passed.

retained_failures.scope: Temporary patch literal guard rejected indentation before any runtime write
retained_failures.correction: Preserve literal indentation and verify both input and expected output SHA-256 before applying the scoped block. The failed attempt made no game change; temporary workflow is removed from the final tree.

Every advanced or imported editor document
Browser-owned file/permission/hardware-binding completion and external account states
next_content: Reconcile and continue the preserved Canal Choice movement-first branch after the XR release. Do not overwrite its fork or replace the new XR workspace with an older file. Presentation acceptance does not complete chapter promotion.
